# TOON reference examples

`reference-v4.1.json` transcribes the TOON 4.1 source's introductory table,
§9.1 empty array rule and Appendix A nested/keyed tables and Unicode examples.
The JSON inputs are the independently reconstructed meanings of those examples;
this is a small extracted reference set, not the full official test suite.
Source: https://github.com/toon-format/spec/blob/v4.1.0/SPEC.md (2026-07-26).
The original review recorded source/hash evidence; that complete evidence archive
was not recovered. See `.missions/AS-M002/recovery/README.md` for this limit.
Production projection tests additionally compare against the separately
implemented TypeScript reference decoder pinned to `@toon-format/toon 4.1.1`.
